summary.text: Wayne Long is serving his second term in the Arkansas House, representing District 39, which includes portions of White, Jackson and Independence Counties; he was first elected to the House in 2022.

paragraphs.text: Before that he served two terms as Justice of the Peace on the Jackson County Quorum Court.
He was born and raised in Faulkner County, graduated from Mayflower High School, and attended the University of Central Arkansas to study Business Administration.
He lives in Bradford with his wife, Jan, where he operates a farm and is a small business owner.
